proposedPrioritySemantics.P0: Protected current-day launch/operational evidence. Reserve first.
proposedPrioritySemantics.P1: Necessary bulk data progress. May consume remaining budget after protected P0 reservation.
proposedPrioritySemantics.P2: Discretionary warmup/bootstrap. Deferrable and quota-adaptive; ordinary push must not physically mutate high-write history.
proposedPrioritySemantics.P3: Maintenance/smoke/schema/deploy. Prefer read-only fast paths; physical mutation requires explicit manual or genuine schema need plus quota reservation.
